identity.name: ruflo
identity.one_liner: Open-source agent meta-harness for orchestrating multi-agent swarms with Claude, adaptive memory, and RAG integration.
identity.short_description: ruflo is an open-source meta-harness for orchestrating multi-agent swarms, primarily designed for Claude-based workflows. It features adaptive memory, self-learning swarm intelligence, RAG integration, and native integration with Claude Code and Codex CLI for coordinated autonomous workflows.

positioning.why_it_matters: ruflo provides a higher-level orchestration layer for teams running multiple Claude agents in production. With 57K+ GitHub stars and active development, it fills the gap between single-agent tools and full agent platforms — particularly for Claude-specific multi-agent deployments.
best_for: Teams running Claude-based multi-agent workflows that need swarm coordination and adaptive memory
Developers building autonomous agent systems with Claude Code and Codex CLI integration
Engineers evaluating meta-orchestration layers for managing multiple AI agents
not_for: Single-agent use cases where a direct Claude API integration is sufficient
Teams that prefer a model-agnostic orchestration framework over Claude-specific tooling

faq.question: What is a meta-harness?
faq.answer: A meta-harness is an orchestration layer that manages multiple AI agents, coordinating their work, memory, and tool access.

faq.question: Does ruflo work with models other than Claude?
faq.answer: ruflo is primarily designed for Claude, with native Claude Code and Codex CLI integration.

faq.question: Is ruflo open source?
faq.answer: Yes, it is open source under the MIT license with 57K+ GitHub stars.

faq.question: What is swarm intelligence in ruflo?
faq.answer: Swarm intelligence allows multiple agents to learn from each other's outputs and adapt their behavior collectively.
